newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Son of S.Korean president withdraws legal action.
newsitem.headline: Son of S.Korean president withdraws legal action.

text.p: The second son of South Korean president Kim Young-sam on Tuesday withdrew legal action against opposition politicians he said defamed him in connection with a loans scandal, a prosecution official said.
Kim Hyun-chul was questioned by state prosecutors on Friday and Saturday over his criminal libel complaints against six members of the opposition National Congress for New Politics.
Prosecutors later said they found no evidence of wrongdoing.
Opposition politicians have said the younger Kim was close to the son of the founder of Hanbo Group, whose steel unit collapsed under a mountain of dubious loans.
Earlier on Tuesday, President Kim apologised over the loans scandal and promised to banish his son from public life until the end of his five-year presidential term next February.
